name: Code target
responsibility: Opens the code a subject is bound to
description: Sends the board, the subject's id and the vault of the pane it is in to the Archboard server, which owns the binding, the opener and the checkout registry, and opens the code at the branch or commit the binding pins. The browser never reads a local path. Also draws the dialog that reads, tests and saves the opener settings. Canonical activation names the model, subject, and selected state or exact checkpoint. The existing opener and notices retain source refusals without substituting current code. A preview code action names the saved mapping origin. The server resolves the current preview before opening its authored binding.
